label: WATCH
rationale: Alphabet is a high-quality AI, Search and Cloud platform with strengthening Cloud economics, but the current GOOGL price is approximately equal to Base modeled value and already requires long-duration double-digit growth plus FCF-margin recovery. The unprecedented 2026-2027 capex cycle, common and preferred dilution, rapidly rising debt and unresolved Search remedies leave external-capital dependence, incremental ROIC, moat shrinkage and concentration vetoes under investigation. With no existing portfolio exposure recorded in the repository, the correct new-coverage decision is WATCH rather than initiating a position.
increase_evidence: Search commercial-query growth and revenue per query improve together after broad AI Mode and AI Overviews adoption.
Google Cloud sustains strong growth and operating margin above 25% after Wiz integration without evidence of capacity dumping.
TTM FCF per share reaccelerates after the capex peak and management provides evidence that AI investment cohorts earn returns above the cost of capital.
Net common dilution, including ATM issuance, SBC settlement and mandatory-convertible effects, is controlled and value-accretive repurchases resume.
The expectation gap widens to at least a 20%-25% discount to defensible Base value or operating evidence lowers the price-implied ten-year growth requirement below 10%.
reduce_or_exit_evidence: Search revenue, commercial-query monetization or market share declines structurally for four consecutive quarters.
AI capex fails to produce FCF-per-share recovery by 2028 or consolidated incremental ROIC falls below the cost of capital.
Cloud growth and operating margin deteriorate together with evidence of material unused capacity or price-led demand.
Annual net dilution exceeds 2% without offsetting FCF-per-share improvement.
Antitrust remedies cause structural deterioration in distribution, TAC, data access or advertising economics.
A material management-integrity or accounting-reliability issue causes a Hard Veto FAIL.
The market price embeds an unrealistic Bull Case or better.
